Official Roberto Prosseda - Topic / Universal Music Group upload; recording credited to Universal Music Italia (2014), released in Mendelssohn: Complete Piano Works (2019). Live YouTube page metadata verified the full fugue title, performer and label; playback status OK and embedding allowed at check. The Structures diagram covers an exposition excerpt only. No bar or entry timing has been measured.

analysis.description: Opening subject and answer entries only, manually transcribed from the score and checked against Saayman's discussion. The rest of the fugue is not represented.

notes: The excerpt covers mm. 1–13. Subject boundaries follow the three-bar core bracketed in Saayman's Example 4.18. The final F-sharp in the two-bar preview continues by a tie into m. 3 in the full score. Manual reading of the public-domain score, corroborated by Saayman's discussion of entry order and subject design. Quarter-note coordinates are relative to each fugue, not to its prelude. Only the opening exposition is mapped. Entry endpoints mark the subject core; continuing counterpoint and extensions are not automatically included.
